prompt: In the workspace where someone reacted with the 👀 emoji to a message about repeated out-of-memory errors from loading large models layer-by-layer, and that same person is also a member of the channel used for infrastructure incidents and on-call, please create a new public channel called retro-notes.
binding_note: Route: workspace(r0) -> channel(r1) via team_id -> message(r2) in that channel -> message_reactions(r3) on that message -> user(r4) as reactor -> channel_members(r5) of that same user in some other channel. r5's channel need not be r1; here it is the infra/on-call channel. Two teams each complete this chain with a different reactor, so r0 is underspecified.

roles.facts: Existing team T01WORKSPACE, containing #engineering (C03IJKL9012) and #core-infra (C_INFRA, topic: Infrastructure, K8s, AWS, on-call, incidents).
roles.reason: Contains a channel (r1=#engineering) whose message (r2) got a 👀 reaction from a user (r4=U01AGENBOT9) who is also a member (r5) of #core-infra.

roles.facts: New team T02NOVA, containing #nova-eng (C_NOVA_ENG) and #nova-infra (C_NOVA_INFRA, topic: Infrastructure, on-call, incidents for Nova cluster).
roles.reason: Contains a parallel chain: #nova-eng message got a 👀 reaction from U_NOVA_OPS, who is also a member of #nova-infra.

roles.facts: Message 1706110000.000100 in C03IJKL9012 authored by U_LUKAS: 'circuit-tracer library is hitting OOM errors when loading large models layer-by-layer... rewrite in PyTorch from scratch with proper streaming.'
roles.reason: Serves as r2 for workspace_T01's chain.

roles.facts: U01AGENBOT9 reacted 👀 on message_oom_T01 and separately holds a channel_members row for C_INFRA.
roles.reason: Serves as r4 for workspace_T01, connecting reaction and the other-channel membership.

roles.facts: {message_id:1706110000.000100, user_id:U01AGENBOT9, reaction_type:eyes} (already present in base seed).
roles.reason: Serves as r3 for workspace_T01's chain.
Serves as r5 for workspace_T01, the reactor's membership in the infra/on-call channel.

roles.facts: New message in C_NOVA_ENG authored by U_NOVA_DEV: 'The tensor pipeline library keeps hitting OOM errors when loading big models across shards - need a full rewrite with proper streaming.'
roles.reason: Serves as r2 for workspace_T02's chain.

roles.facts: U_NOVA_OPS reacted 👀 on message_oom_T02 and separately holds a channel_members row for C_NOVA_INFRA.

roles.reason: Serves as r3 for workspace_T02's chain.
Serves as r5 for workspace_T02, the reactor's membership in the infra/on-call channel.

roles.facts: {message_id:1706110000.000100, user_id:U_PRIYA, reaction_type:thumbsup}; U_PRIYA also holds a channel_members row for C_INFRA.
roles.reason: Right message and a valid other-channel membership, but the reaction emoji is thumbsup, not eyes, so this pairing does not satisfy r3.

roles.facts: {message_id:1706076473.000000 (Acme hallucinated-refund-policy message in C_MODEL), user_id:U_OLENA, reaction_type:eyes}; U_OLENA also holds a channel_members row for C_INFRA.
roles.reason: Right emoji and a valid other-channel membership, but the reacted message concerns a hallucinated refund policy, not OOM/layer-streaming, so r2 fails.

roles.facts: U_NOVA_QA reacted 👀 on message_oom_T02 (message_reactions row {message_oom_T02, U_NOVA_QA, eyes}) but only holds a channel_members row for C_NOVA_ENG, not C_NOVA_INFRA.
roles.reason: Right emoji and right message, but this reactor has no membership record satisfying r5, so the chain breaks for this person.

obligations.name: identify_workspace
obligations.description: Resolve which team (r0) contains a channel (r1) whose message (r2) received a 👀 reaction (r3) from a user (r4) who separately holds a channel_members row (r5) in that team's infra/on-call channel; workspace_T01 (via U01AGENBOT9) and workspace_T02 (via U_NOVA_OPS) both complete this chain, leaving r0 underspecified.
obligations.scope: teams reachable through the actor's channel memberships and visible reaction/message history

obligations.name: create_channel
obligations.description: Create a brand-new public channel named retro-notes inside whichever team is resolved by identify_workspace; no matching channel exists yet, so this obligation has no positive target records.
obligations.scope: a new channel record scoped to the resolved workspace's team_id

task_spec.text: Determine which workspace contains the message-reaction-membership chain described (OOM/layer-streaming message, 👀 reaction, same reactor also holding membership in the infra/on-call channel).
Create a public channel named retro-notes inside that resolved workspace.

access_plan: The acting bot (U01AGENBOT9) is a member of channels in both T01WORKSPACE (#engineering, #core-infra) and the newly added T02NOVA (#nova-eng, #nova-infra), so conversations.history/conversations.replies can surface the OOM/layer-streaming messages in each team, reactions.get can confirm the 👀 reactor on each, and conversations.members can confirm that same reactor's membership in the respective infra/on-call channel. Because two teams satisfy the chain, the workspace remains underspecified until clarified or a deliberate choice is made; conversations.create then takes the resolved team_id to add the retro-notes channel.
